links.outcome: Demographic and trait stereotyping in AI-generated images of anesthesiologists versus actual workforce data
links.effect: Models portrayed anesthesiologists as White (DALL-E2 64.2%, Midjourney 83.0%); younger anesthesiologists underrepresented; traits like masculine, attractive, trustworthy predominated. Discrepancies with ASA and ESAIC data were significant.
links.quote: The models predominantly portrayed anesthesiologists as White, with ChatGPT DALL-E2 at 64.2% and Midjourney at 83.0%.

screen.reason: Empirical audit of demographic biases and representation in text-to-image AI generators depicting the anesthesiology workforce.
